extraction.notes: Amending act only, in Serbian Latin script, as posted by the National Employment Service. No English text of the act was found, and the NES English page summarises it only. A text search of the act finds no mention of the European Union, EU citizens or accession ("evropsk", "pristupanj"). It amends the law of Sl. glasnik 128/14, 113/17, 50/18 and 31/19, but the consolidated law was not reached (SRB-GOV-2023-003), so this source cannot show whether the 2014 accession clause survives.

items.stated_text: Zapošljavanje stranca ostvaruje se pod uslovom da poseduje vizu za duži boravak po osnovu zapošljavanja, odobrenje za privremeni boravak ili stalno nastanjenje i jedinstvenu dozvolu, ako ovim zakonom nije drugačije utvrđeno.
items.translation_en: A foreigner may be employed on condition of holding a long-stay visa on the grounds of employment, approval of temporary residence or permanent settlement, and a single permit, unless this law provides otherwise.
items.summary: Foreigners may be employed only with a long-stay visa, residence approval and a single permit, unless otherwise provided.

items.stated_text: Organizacija nadležna za poslove zapošljavanja na zahtev poslodavca sprovodi test tržišta rada odnosno međuregionalno posredovanje u zapošljavanju (u daljem tekstu: test tržišta rada), shodnom primenom propisa iz oblasti zapošljavanja, tako što utvrđuje da li se na evidenciji organizacije nadležne za poslove zapošljavanja nalaze lica koja odgovaraju uslovima iz zahteva poslodavca za konkretno radno mesto, odnosno lica koja ostvaruju pravo na rad u skladu sa ovim zakonom i koja odgovaraju uslovima iz zahteva poslodavca za konkretno radno mesto.
items.translation_en: At the employer's request, the employment organisation conducts a labour market test or interregional employment mediation (the labour market test), applying employment regulations accordingly, by establishing whether its register contains persons who meet the conditions of the employer's request for the specific post, or persons who have the right to work under this law and meet those conditions.
items.summary: The employment organisation runs a labour market test, checking its register for suitable persons for the post.
